definition: Abandonment of a religious or political belief.
author: Wilkie Collins
quote: If the annals of apostasy offer anything comparable to such a declaration as that, I can only say that the case in point is not producible from the stores of my reading.
example_sentence: Switching football teams was seen as apostasy in our house.
